fact: RazorpayX processes annualised transaction volume (neobanking/business banking arm)
value: $30 billion, with 85% YoY growth; 50,000+ businesses use RazorpayX

fact: Razorpay overall consolidated revenue FY25
value: Rs 3,783 crore, up 65% YoY from Rs 2,296 crore in FY24

fact: Razorpay total annualised Total Payment Volume (TPV) and merchant base
value: $180 billion TPV, 8 million+ merchants, ~55% share of India's online payment gateway market, valued at $9.2B (June 2025)

fact: RazorpayX Payouts pricing
value: Free current account; 250 free payouts/month then ~₹2-5 per payout depending on rail/volume (₹1.5 up to ₹1,000; ₹3 for ₹1,000-25,000; ₹7 above ₹25,000)

fact: RazorpayX Corporate Card default user roles
value: Owner/Admin (full access & approval), Finance (transactions & repayments), Cardholder (view own card/transactions only), Viewer (view all org cards) — no "staff-initiated payout with bill upload" role exists

fact: RazorpayX Vendor Payments / AP automation core workflow
value: OCR invoice capture, 3-way PO-GRN-Invoice matching, multi-layer team/amount-based approval workflows, one-click payouts from dashboard — fundamentally a desk/dashboard-led, invoice-first flow, not phone-first staff-initiated payment

fact: UPI Circle (NPCI delegated payments) limits
value: Primary user can add up to 5 secondary users; Full Delegation allows secondary user to transact without per-transaction approval up to ₹5,000 per transaction and ₹15,000 per month; Partial Delegation requires primary's UPI PIN each time; a secondary user can be linked to only one primary

fact: UPI Circle launch date and purpose
value: Launched by NPCI on August 13, 2024, to let primary UPI account holders delegate payment capability to trusted secondary users without sharing bank credentials

fact: UPI overall scale FY2025-26 / India digital payments dominance
value: 24,162 crore annual transactions (FY25-26), ₹314 lakh crore annual value, UPI ~85% of India's digital payments by FY2025-26, ~49% of world's real-time payment volume

fact: UPI P2M (merchant) share of transaction volume vs value
value: P2M = 63% of UPI volume but only ~28-29% of value; 86% of P2M transactions are under ₹500 (small-ticket, high-frequency) — consistent with vendor/kirana micro-payments

fact: UPI QR code / merchant acceptance network growth
value: UPI QR codes grew 91.5% to 65.8 crore (658 million) in 2024-25; PoS terminals grew 24.7% to 1.1 crore; ~70 million QR-enabled merchants nationwide, mostly kirana/micro-merchants ("Kirana Effect")

fact: UPI accounts for majority of India's retail digital payments
value: UPI handled 84% of India's retail payment transaction volume in FY25 per RBI Annual Report; 185.9 billion UPI transactions in FY25 vs 131.1 billion in FY24 (41.7% growth)

fact: Indian MSME sector size and employment
value: ~63.4 million MSMEs in India (630.5 lakh micro, 3.3 lakh small, ~0.05 lakh medium); MSMEs employ ~111 million people and contribute ~27-31% of GDP, ~45-48% of exports

fact: Udyam-registered MSME count (formal/registered segment)
value: 4,71,55,579 (~4.72 crore) MSMEs registered on Udyam portal as of June 2026; 98.9% are micro enterprises, ~4.9 lakh small, only 37,042 medium

fact: UPI preference and merchant digital acceptance survey (govt-backed, 2025)
value: UPI is preferred by 57% of transactions vs cash at 38%; 94% of small merchants now accept UPI; 72% of merchants satisfied with digital transactions; 57% reported sales increase after adopting digital payments (survey of 10,378 respondents incl. 2,199 merchants across 15 states)

fact: OkCredit (digital khata app) scale
value: OkCredit has 5,000,000+ installs on Play Store (and is described elsewhere as used by 30 million+ MSMEs), serving 50+ business categories across 2,800+ Indian cities for udhar/credit ledger tracking

fact: Open Money (neobank for SMEs) positioning and pricing
value: Open offers business current account + connected banking (60+ banks), bookkeeping, GST invoicing, VISA debit cards for employees with limits, and a "Founder One Card"; pricing tiers Free/₹1,199-₹1,499/₹5,599-₹6,999 per month depending on plan

fact: EnKash prepaid corporate card issuance speed and positioning
value: EnKash issues prepaid corporate cards (reloadable up to ₹2,00,000, MCC-locked) in under 60 seconds via its own RBI-authorised PPI license (not bank-routed); eliminates employee reimbursements; backed by $23M funding, 5,000+ businesses

fact: Pleo (European SME spend management analogue) model
value: Pleo issues employees smart company cards with individual pre-set spend limits; employees photograph receipts via app for instant capture (no expense reports); serves European SMEs ~5-200 employees; pricing €0-€79/month tiers

fact: Ramp vs Brex spend control enforcement difference (global analogue for pre- vs post-transaction control)
value: Ramp blocks out-of-policy spend before the transaction completes (hard decline at point of sale); Brex sets policy thresholds that trigger alerts/review after the fact — illustrates "block vs notify" trade-off relevant to H3
